greeting: Holographic Archivist on comms. Stage 3: Memories in Stone. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Ascent. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I put fear on a schedule. It keeps missing meetings.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Activate the ancient records.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Activate the ancient records; Learn the truth of the Unraveling; Understand the Progenitors' sacrifice. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Witness holographic records of the Progenitors' final days. Immediate move: Activate the ancient records.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: Memories in Stone. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Penultimate Step.
rumor: Arena chalk marks now redraw themselves after every storm.
People keep repeating one clue from Memories in Stone: 'Understand the Progenitors' sacrifice'.
If your shadow starts giving tactical advice, charge it rent and keep walking.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in the tower is maintenance hour. Security patterns are predictable.
dialog.time_noon: Noon rotations overlap. Expect stacked encounters and less recovery time.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk shadowing in tower arenas hides projectile tells. Keep spacing.
dialog.time_night: Night floor clears are endurance checks. Pace your resources.

party_reactions.kade: Holographic Archivist sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Holographic Archivist accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Holographic Archivist talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
